product.title: Bone Conduction Speakers: Wireless BT Connectivity, Loud Stereo Sound, Built-in Mic for Hands-Free Calls, FM Radio, Aluminum Body
product.body_html:
What is this bone conduction speaker?

It's the most compact and adaptable bone conduction speaker globally, offering a unique yet exceptional auditory encounter wherever you are, regardless of the environment. Transform any hollow object into a speaker whenever you desire.

A Versatile Audio Companion

This speaker enables you to enjoy music, tune into podcasts, engage in one-on-one phone conversations or group conference calls, and immerse yourself in the captivating audio of games, videos, or movies on your device.

Variety of Sounds Across Surfaces

Utilizing bone conduction technology, this compact speaker offers a customizable sound experience, allowing you to experiment with and relish various auditory tones. By placing it on different surfaces like guitars, Kraft boxes, plastic storage containers, photo frames, sports headphones, or even dashboards, you can explore an array of sound effects akin to using different musical instruments.

Using a Single Speaker:

1. Hold down the power button until you hear a beep indicating "Bluetooth Mode" activation.
2. Enable Bluetooth in the settings menu of your mobile phone or device.
3. Select "Scan" to discover available devices and locate "Humbird Speaker."
4. Upon successful connection, you'll hear a voice prompt confirming "Connected successfully."


Pairing Two Speakers for Stereo Sound:

1. Simultaneously power on both speakers by pressing their respective power buttons.
2. After 5-8 seconds, the two speakers will automatically pair, with voice prompts indicating "left channel" and "right channel" to signify successful synchronization.

Instructions for FM Radio Mode:

1. While in Bluetooth mode, briefly press the power button to switch to FM radio mode. You'll hear a prompt indicating "radio mode."
2. Press and hold the function key for 3 seconds to initiate automatic FM station search.
3. Once the station search is completed, the speaker will automatically store the searched stations.
4. Volume Control:
- Single-click the button to decrease the volume.
- Double-click the button to increase the volume.
- Triple-click the button to switch between radio stations.

Note: Before initiating the radio, ensure the USB cable is inserted into the charging port of the speaker to serve as the FM radio antenna, particularly for optimal reception during outdoor use.
